rules.ambiguous_policy: ambiguous rows score only when existing evidence explicitly demoted them
rules.scoring: points_awarded equals significance_score if bet matches scoring_side; otherwise 0
rules.thumbs_down: scores when evidence_outcome is FAILURE or DEMOTED_FAILURE
rules.thumbs_up: scores when evidence_outcome is SUCCESS or PARTIAL_SUCCESS
